messages.content: The watch looks much more worn than in your photos. The bezel fading is really significant.
I clearly stated 'slight fading, adds character' in the listing. This is a 30-year-old watch. What were you expecting?
Slight fading doesn't match what I received. Your photos must have been color-corrected. And you didn't mention the loose bracelet link.
The photos were taken in natural lighting with my iPhone, no editing. The bracelet was properly sized and secure when shipped. Any jeweler can adjust a link for minimal cost.
